R13 adaptation notes (not source code):

1. Treat editor import, scene construction, project execution and observable capture as distinct gates. A serialized scene alone is not runtime proof.
2. Derive collision from measured geometry bounds rather than visual intuition or case coordinates.
3. Capture deterministic evidence with a fixed frame rate and pre-positioned camera, then verify that the recording contains progressing behavior rather than a static frame.
4. Keep durable status and explicit checkpoints so a failed environment-analysis phase cannot be reported as a completed playable prototype.

Applied in R13 as separate import/analyze/canonicalize/capture gates. No Godogen scaffold, agent loop, prompt runtime or code is copied.
